prompt: A producer runs XADD orders * customer 42. What does the asterisk ask the server to do?
explanation: With * the server generates the entry ID itself, taking the current server time in milliseconds plus a sequence number, giving IDs like 1712345678901-0. IDs also define ordering inside the stream, so letting the server assign them keeps entries strictly increasing.

options.text: Generate the entry ID from the current time in milliseconds and a sequence number
Insert the entry with the highest possible priority
Create the stream if it is missing and do nothing else
Mark the entry as already delivered to every consumer group
